<template>
  <component :is="tag" :class="headingClass" :style="headingStyle">
    <slot></slot>
  </component>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
interface Props {
  tag?: 'h1' | 'h2' | 'h3' | 'h4' | 'h5' | 'h6';
  size?: 'small' | 'medium' | 'large' | 'xlarge';
  color?: 'primary' | 'accent' | 'secondary';
  weight?: 'normal' | 'medium' | 'semibold' | 'bold';
  align?: 'left' | 'center' | 'right';
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  tag: 'h2',
  size: 'medium',
  color: 'accent',
  weight: 'semibold',
  align: 'left'
});

const sizeClasses = {
  small: 'text-lg',
  medium: 'text-xl',
  large: 'text-2xl',
  xlarge: 'text-3xl'
};

const colorClasses = {
  primary: 'text-gray-300',
  accent: 'text-blue-400',
  secondary: 'text-gray-400'
};

const weightClasses = {
  normal: 'font-normal',
  medium: 'font-medium',
  semibold: 'font-semibold',
  bold: 'font-bold'
};

const alignClasses = {
  left: 'text-left',
  center: 'text-center',
  right: 'text-right'
};

const headingClass = computed(() => [
  sizeClasses[props.size],
  colorClasses[props.color],
  weightClasses[props.weight],
  alignClasses[props.align]
]);

const headingStyle = computed(() => ({
  color: getColorValue(props.color)
}));

function getColorValue(color: string) {
  const colors = {
    primary: 'rgb(209, 213, 219)', // gray-300
    accent: 'rgb(96, 165, 250)', // blue-400
    secondary: 'rgb(156, 163, 175)' // gray-400
  };
  return colors[color as keyof typeof colors] || colors.accent;
}
</script>

<style scoped>
/* Ensure the styles are applied */
h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
  color: inherit !important;
}
</style>
